description: Rhythm, position and composition rules. Every rule id here is implemented in schema/semantic_validate.py with the same severity; verify_all.py (GRAPH_VALIDATOR_AGREEMENT) fails if the two sets diverge. 'warn' rules are reported but never fail validation.

rules.description: The PageSpec validates against schema/pagespec.schema.json (Draft-07).
`template` names a template in templates/templates.json.
The PageSpec's node sequence matches its declared template's real node list in order, keyed on (section, variant), honouring required/repeatable/min/max.
If `route` is one of the 7 snapshot routes, `template` must be the template routes.json binds to it.
Route falls in a future-wave family (team, use-case, store, company) with no template evidence in this snapshot.
The first node is shell.header.
The last node is shell.footer.
Sections whose contract sets constraints.onePerPage appear at most once.
Sections with constraints.homeRouteOnly (shell.banner, hero.carousel) only appear when route is '/'; shell.banner must directly follow the header.
Exactly one hero.* node.

exceptions.reason: The pricing page has no hero; pricing.suite-intro owns the page h1 (src/components/plans/SuiteIntro.jsx). The rule then requires exactly one pricing.suite-intro and zero hero.* nodes.

rules.description: The hero (or pricing.suite-intro) is the first node after the header and optional banner.
Two consecutive nodes do not use the same section id.

exceptions.reason: Real runs of 5 (/mail), 4 (/enterprise) and 2 (/docs, /agents) consecutive rows.
Real runs of 4 and 5 rows on /go.
/go renders a 4-card row then a 2-card row.

rules.description: Nodes sharing a `group` id are consecutive.
Nodes in one group share one background.

exceptions.reason: paintsOwnBackground: /mail M3 paints #281647 inside the #f2f0eb group A (src/pages/Mail.jsx).

rules.description: `context` equals the context of the node's background surface (tokens/10-semantic/surface.json).
`background` is one of the section contract's allowedBackgrounds (surfaces observed for that section).
Content fields marked onlyForVariants/requiredForVariants appear only with (and are present for) those variants.
Per-variant item counts from the contract (proof.logo-strip: rotating 9-11 logos, static exactly 6).
Exactly one plan in pricing.plan-cards has highlight: true.
The light footer tone appears only with the neutral-5 header (the /go pairing); the dark footer with a white header.
The node before the footer is a conversion section (cta.*).
faq.accordion is followed only by cta.* nodes and the footer.
pricing.suite-intro precedes pricing.plan-cards, which precedes pricing.comparison.
Every run of feature.sticky-row is directly preceded by chapter.intro.
motion.pattern (and each additional pattern) is allowed by the section contract; byVariant patterns must match the node variant.
Every motion object carries the reducedMotionFallback locked to its pattern (compatibility/motion-patterns.json).
At most one carousel-crossfade and at most one logo-rotate per page.
Every text field is within its contract's maxWords.
Every text field (and rich-text total) is within its contract's maxChars / maxTotalChars.
Each media field's assetRole is listed for that field in the section contract and exists in assets/asset-roles.json.
No PageSpec text contains the original company's brand name or a reference to the excluded original-site material.

evidence: recommendedAfter pairs are adjacencies that occur in at least one real template node list (templates/templates.json).
